{{Otheruses|Totem}}
{{Quote|The study of the natural ways involves many years of the strictest devotion. Terrible things can happen to a young wizard who foolishly misuses his knowledge. You must be willing to spend long hours doing the simplest tasks before you're ready to work your first spells.|translated=1|The Ewok shaman Logray explains the dangers of totem magic to his apprentice, Teebo|<ref name="svs">{{Ewoks|Sunstar vs. Shadowstone}}</ref>}}
'''Totem magic''' was a means of using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] employed by various [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. With little to no contact with users of other Force traditions, such as the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Force-users on the moon came to rely on physical objects to help them access the Force.<ref name="COE 2">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref>

Types of totem magic practiced on Endor included [[Dulok sorcery]], [[Ewok shamanism]], and [[Gupin magic]]. Despite superficial differences between these disciplines, their underlying mechanics were the same.<ref name="COE 2" />

Practitioners of totem magic sometimes employed [[Force artifact/Legends|Force artifacts]] to help magnify their natural Force abilities. Examples of these relics on Endor included the [[Season scepter]], the [[Shadowstone]], and the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]].<ref name="COE 2" />

A form of totem magic was also used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of Dathomir, who were known to craft small idols representing someone they wished to inflict harm on, and, with great effort and expenditure of [[Spirit ichor/Legends|spirit ichor]], suffuse them with the life energy of the victim through a strand of hair and a roiling cauldron containing the "[[Water of Life/Legends|waters of life]]." By pricking the totem with needles or even throwing it in a boiling cauldron, they could transfer the pain through the "[[Spirit (Nightsisters)|spirits]]" to the victim it represented.<ref name="BoSSftDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> During the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|attack]] on the Nightsisters during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] used this technique against [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], a lock of whose hair she kept.<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>
